description: Deterministic in-memory cases for the growing token catalog validator, renderer, and history guard.

behavior.name: native-deployments-have-null-address
behavior.expect: one native deployment per supported chain and no fake address

behavior.name: evm-address-normalization
behavior.expect: lowercase canonical storage and case-insensitive lookup

behavior.name: base-catalog-identity
behavior.expect: Base uses eip155:8453, three additive deployment IDs, native null address, and exact aliases

behavior.name: wrapped-and-token-2022-identity
behavior.expect: classic WSOL and Token-2022 WSOL remain distinct deployment IDs and standards; both share the wrapped-SOL asset ID and are never auto-converted

behavior.name: lifecycle-visibility
behavior.expect: active, legacy, winding-down, and retired records remain queryable

behavior.name: offline-lookup
behavior.expect: lookup and filtering require no RPC, API key, client, or network

behavior.name: unclassified-growth
behavior.expect: newly discovered assets may remain unclassified only while stableCurrency and both relation IDs are null

previous.identity: assetId and deploymentId values are opaque and immutable
previous.deletionPolicy: historical assets, deployments, and aliases may not be deleted

validMigration.name: lifecycle-only-update
validMigration.expect: compareHistory accepts status changes while identity, binding, and aliases remain fixed

invalidCases.name: decimal-out-of-range
invalidCases.expectError: decimals must be an integer from 0 through 255

invalidCases.name: alias-unknown-namespace
invalidCases.expectError: namespace must be one of ethereum, solana, avalancheC, base

invalidCases.name: alias-wrong-chain
invalidCases.expectError: namespace ethereum must target a deployment on eip155:1
